item.title: GTA 6 Release Window Confirmed for Spring 2027
item.dc:creator: IGN Editorial
item.description: Rockstar has confirmed GTA 6 will release in spring 2027. First on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
item.content:encoded:
Rockstar Games today confirmed GTA 6 will launch in spring 2027.

First on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, PC version delayed.
